name: SMT101 MQTT Sensors
description: Subscribes to SMT101 MQTT topics and exposes temperature, humidity, light, and digital inputs as Kiosk Satellite entities.
author: Stuart Pearson

settings.title: MQTT broker host
settings.description: Broker hostname or IP address. Leave blank to keep the plugin idle.

settings.title: MQTT broker port
settings.description: Broker port. Use 8883 for TLS or another port that matches your broker.

settings.title: MQTT password
settings.description: Optional MQTT password. Stored by Kiosk Satellite like any other plugin setting.

settings.title: Use TLS
settings.description: Connect with ssl:// instead of tcp://.

settings.title: MQTT client ID
settings.description: Optional client ID. Leave blank to generate one automatically for each plugin session.

settings.title: Topic prefix
settings.description: Prefix that precedes the fixed SMT101 topic suffixes, for example smt101 or floor1/smt101.

settings.title: Enable temperature, humidity, and light
settings.description: Expose the three numeric sensor entities.

settings.title: Enable digital inputs
settings.description: Expose input1 and input2 as binary sensors.
